performance.verdict: Meta spend went dark Aug 6; all 43 leads are pre-blackout, not current.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 — 14 consecutive zero-spend days; all 43 leads and $1,024 spend are pre-blackout, not active.
GHL shows 31 contacts vs 43 Meta leads with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — a confirmed intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions collapsed from ~12/day peak to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 17–19); 75% weekly drop likely signals listing suppression or engagement loss.
IG reach hit 0 for 13 consecutive days (Aug 7–19), a -100% delta; organic social is fully dark alongside paid, suggesting account-level issue.
Search clicks averaged 16/day Aug 10–19 vs 14/day prior 10 days — organic search holding, partially offsetting paid blackout, but GA4 sessions directional only.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta spend immediately; identify billing, policy, or account access block causing 14-day zero-spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since August 6 — 14 consecutive days with no delivery and no leads. IG reach simultaneously dropped to 0 on the same date, pointing to an account-level event (billing lapse, policy flag, or access issue) rather than a campaign setting. Confirm the account status, payment method, and any Meta policy notifications in Business Manager today. Success = spend resumes at the prior $65–75/day rate and IG reach returns above 0 by August 22.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 43 leads arrived but 0 opportunities created — find and close the pipeline gap before next leads arrive.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL logged 31 contacts against 43 Meta leads with zero opportunities created and zero appointments set. This is a CRM intake leak — leads are arriving but not being converted to pipeline entries, likely a workflow, stage, or Andrew-side Zoho sync issue. Coordinate with Andrew to trace one recent lead end-to-end and confirm where the handoff breaks. Success = every new lead from Meta creates a GHL opportunity within 24 hours of form submission, confirmed by August 25.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for Aug 17–19 after averaging 8/day in July — re-check Aug 23 for listing suppression confirmation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 75% week-over-week and hit 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 17–19), after averaging roughly 8 actions/day through July. This is probable listing suppression or a ranking drop, but one data gap could be a reporting lag. No action is taken this cycle. Re-check on August 23 — if actions remain below 3/day, escalate to a GBP audit (listing status, review flags, category accuracy).
